LanguageData.AnimaSong_AllowListeningDesc: Allow colonists to sit in a ring around this anima tree and hear it sing, as recreation.\n\nTurn it off to keep them away — before a psychic linking ritual, for instance, or when the tree stands somewhere dangerous. Colonists already listening leave at once.
LanguageData.AnimaSong_OrderFull: the tree has all the listeners it takes
LanguageData.AnimaSong_OrderNoSeat: no free spot around the tree
